description: Review Git commits since tag v1.5.0 and create CHANGELOG.md for v2.0 release. Use VSCode's Source Control panel or Git integration to review commit history. Create file at /home/ga/workspace/webapp/CHANGELOG.md with three sections: '## Features' (list new features like dark mode, CSV export, batch processing, keyboard shortcuts), '## Bug Fixes' (list fixes like null username crash, empty CSV data handling, memory leak), and '## Breaking Changes' (mention API.fetchData signature change). Filter out internal commits (refactors, tests, dependency bumps). Use standard Markdown format with version header '## [2.0.0]'.
